description: Interested on Hardware and Software working together, special interest on Machine Learning and AI development.
summary: Ridge Support System focuses on a decision support interface based on multiple biometric parameters measured with a Xiaomi Mi Band 5 (Model XMSH10HM; Xiaomi Inc., Beijing, China).  The interface is web based, it monitors heart rate, stress, burnt calories and steps. All of these are measured in real time, the other parameters that we can't measure are simulated, these can be modified with the included slider.
details: The project works using machine learning to predict any incoming health issue in the astronauts aboard, using real-time monitoring combined with a daily test. This test is designed to receive data from physical activities on a monitoring clock and a physical test they have to perform daily, including an emotional test. All of this is tracked and shown on an intuitive and dynamic dashboard. We use Python to build and train the machine learning modules, as well as for communication via Bluetooth with the monitoring clock, and JavaScript to build the UI. This has an impact on the ease with which the astronauts can check and monitor their health, with a summary section containing the essentials and another tab to check every single parameter. Our team accounted for issues like oxygen, blood pressure, stress levels, sleep quality and time, glucose in the blood, BPM, emotional and psychological factors, radiation, muscle density and atrophy, muscle mass, among others. The creativity of this project is in how to present the information to the astronauts without making it hard to understand, besides having preprogrammed feedback when specific values cause a warning or a critical alert so they can take action immediately.
